support_claim: Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party, and the packet instructs that the registry link be treated as unresolved.
justification: Under the identity_judgment contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing evidence of identity, not name compatibility; the packet preserves multiple live registry candidates (including a Wyoming LLC) and explicitly states the billing-to-registry link cannot be established, so neither SAME_ENTITY nor DISTINCT is licensed.
